bull_bear.body: Dividend Rs.1.50/share (final) + Rs.2.00/share (interim); Free Cash Flow Rs.826cr (100% of PAT); Active M&A in medical (asset purchase closed).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: EV financing availability for fleet operators; Charging infrastructure deployment delays; Railway approval timelines; Commodity price volatility lag; Geopolitical impact on medical exports (Middle East).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Bullish on volume growth despite macro headwinds; Pragmatic on cost pass-through lags; Confident in supply chain fixes (BIW in-house); Strategic patience on railway/tech shifts.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: EV three-wheeler volume miss was a deliberate short-term hit to solve a multi-year supplier bottleneck by acquiring the facility, enabling immediate ramp-up in April/May; Shift in long-haul EV strategy from battery-swap to high-capacity fast-charging based on China trends, though swap retained for ports.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Engineering: Rev Rs.1,495cr (+21.6% YoY), PBIT Rs.176cr; Metal Formed: Rev Rs.421cr (+4.5% YoY), PBIT Rs.35cr (-10% YoY) impacted by Hyundai muted growth/railway tender margins; Mobility (EV): Rev Rs.208cr (+14.9% YoY), PBIT Rs.4cr (flat); Volumes: 87 Big Trucks, 241 SCV, 1,176 Three-wheelers; Medical: Rev Rs.246cr (+0.8% YoY), PBIT Rs.16cr.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply chain bottleneck resolved by in-house takeover | Tube Investments of India Ltd | beneficiary | High | BIW facility acquisition removes structural cap on 3W volumes; immediate ramp expected in Q1 FY27. |
| Commodity inflation lag and railway tender margin pressure | Shanthi Gears Ltd | loser | Med | Revenue declined 11.8% YoY; margin compression in gear segment due to product mix and slower industrial demand. |
| High deployment capex and charging infra gaps | CG Power & Industrial Solutions | beneficiary | High | Strong 25% revenue growth and 27% PBIT growth provide cash flow cushion for group; benefits from broader power capex cycle unrelated to EV infra delays. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: Consolidated Revenue Rs.6,215cr (+20.7% YoY), PBIT Rs.516cr (+7.7% YoY); Standalone Revenue Rs.2,279cr (+16.5% YoY), PBIT Rs.176cr (Eng) + Rs.35cr (MFP) + Rs.4cr (Mobility); CG Power Revenue Rs.3,442cr (+25% YoY), PBIT Rs.490cr (+27.6% YoY); Shanthi Gears Revenue Rs.135cr (-11.8% YoY), PBIT Rs.25cr (-19.4% YoY); One-off: Q4 EV volumes capped at ~50% potential due to supplier bottleneck resolution.
latest_quarter.title: Financial scorecard

latest_quarter.body: Commodity price inflation passed through with 1-2 quarter lag; Fuel cost inflation immediate challenge being negotiated; MFP margins pressured by low-margin railway tenders and Hyundai volume mix.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Standalone Capex Rs.300-350cr; Subsidiary Capex ~Rs.300cr; TI Medical growth 15-20% YoY; EV deployment ramping in Q1/Q2 FY27 post-infrastructure financing resolution; CDMO commercial production starts Q1 FY27.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: EV Heavy Trucks: Strong order book cited (specific value undisclosed); Deployment pending financing/charging infra; Three-wheeler order flow recovering post-supply fix.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Railway Vande Bharat component certification (2-3 quarters away); CDMO plant commissioning (Naidupet); IV Cannula asset acquisition (Ambala) starting production Q1/Q2 FY27; EV long-haul battery swap vs. fast-charge technology pivot.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: TII delivered robust consolidated growth (Revenue +21% YoY) driven by CG Power and core Engineering, while standalone EV mobility faced temporary supply constraints now resolved via in-house capacity capture. The strategic pivot to internalize body-in-white production and pending railway certifications positions FY27 for accelerated volume recovery despite near-term commodity cost headwinds.

drhp.business: Tube Investments of India Limited manufactures a broad range of engineered products organised into segments including precision steel tubes and strips (Engineering), metal-formed products such as automotive chains and railway wagon sections, mobility products including standard and specialty bicycles, and gears, motors and drives. The Company has expanded into Power Systems (transformers, switchgears, automation and turnkey projects), semiconductors (OSAT and fabless design), and new-venture electric vehicles.

sk.overview: The industry covers control-intensive, critical-to-the-application electronic control units (ECUs) for the mobility (2/3-wheeler) and industrial (generator/genset) markets. In mobility, ECUs (ISG, EFI, ISG+EFI, EV motor control units) are indispensable to vehicle function; adoption is driven by regulation (emissions/efficiency) and OEM technology transitions, with Tier-I suppliers driving innovation.
